name: US GAAP
description: Standard US Generally Accepted Accounting Principles reporting taxonomy

children.name: Assets
children.description: All economic resources owned by the entity

children.name: Current Assets
children.description: Assets expected to be converted to cash within one year

children.name: Cash
children.description: Cash on hand and in bank accounts

children.name: FX Translation Reserve on Cash
children.description: FX remeasurement reserve attributable to cash

children.name: Hedge Reserve on Cash
children.description: Cash flow hedge reserve adjustments on cash

children.name: Cash Equivalents
children.description: Highly liquid investments with original maturity of 3 months or less

children.name: Short-Term Investments
children.description: Marketable securities held for sale within one year

children.name: Held-to-Maturity Securities
children.description: HTM debt securities at amortized cost

children.name: Equity Method Investments
children.description: Investments accounted for under equity method

children.name: Accounts Receivable
children.description: Amounts due from customers for goods or services delivered

children.name: Unbilled AR
children.description: Revenue earned but not yet invoiced

children.name: Allowance for Doubtful Accounts
children.description: Contra-asset reducing AR for expected uncollectibles

children.name: Notes Receivable - Current
children.description: Notes receivable due within one year

children.name: Notes Receivable - Long-Term
children.description: Notes receivable due beyond one year

children.name: LIFO Reserve
children.description: Difference between LIFO and FIFO inventory value

children.name: Lower of Cost or NRV Adjustment
children.description: Inventory write-down to net realizable value

children.name: Raw Materials In-Transit
children.description: Raw materials shipped but not received

children.name: Finished Goods - In-Transit
children.description: Finished goods in transit to customers

children.name: Prepaid Expenses
children.description: Expenses paid in advance of being incurred

children.name: Non-Current Assets
children.description: Assets not expected to be converted to cash within one year

children.name: Property, Plant and Equipment
children.description: Tangible long-lived assets used in operations

children.name: Land
children.description: Land held for use in operations

children.name: Goodwill
children.description: Excess of acquisition cost over fair value of net assets acquired

children.name: Right-of-Use Asset
children.description: Lessee right to use leased asset (ASC 842)

children.name: Deferred Tax Asset
children.description: Future deductible amounts net of valuation allowance

children.name: Long-Term Investments
children.description: Investments held longer than one year

children.name: Accrued Liabilities
children.description: Expenses incurred but not yet paid

children.name: Accrued Payroll
children.description: Wages and salaries owed but not yet paid

children.name: Line of Credit
children.description: Drawn amounts on revolving credit facility

children.name: Sales Tax Payable
children.description: Collected sales tax owed to government

children.name: Payroll Tax Payable
children.description: Withheld and employer payroll taxes owed

children.name: Income Tax Payable
children.description: Income taxes owed but not yet paid

children.name: Deferred Revenue - Subscription Current
children.description: Current portion of subscription deferred revenue

children.name: Lease Liability - Current
children.description: Current portion of operating lease obligation

children.name: Current Portion of Long-Term Debt
children.description: Principal payments due within one year on LTD

children.name: Long-Term Debt
children.description: Loans and bonds with maturity beyond one year

children.name: Lease Liability - Non-Current
children.description: Non-current portion of operating lease obligation

children.name: Stockholders' Equity
children.description: Owners' residual interest in net assets

children.name: Common Stock
children.description: Par value of issued common shares

children.name: Preferred Stock
children.description: Par value of issued preferred shares

children.name: Additional Paid-In Capital
children.description: Capital contributed in excess of par value

children.name: Retained Earnings
children.description: Cumulative net income retained in the business

children.name: Current Year Net Income
children.description: Current period net income to RE

children.name: Outbound Freight
children.description: Freight out to customers in COGS

children.name: Operating Expenses
children.description: Selling, general, administrative and R&D expenses

children.name: Equity Method Income
children.description: Share of equity method investee earnings

children.name: Equity Method Loss
children.description: Share of equity method investee loss

children.name: Income Tax Expense
children.description: Current and deferred income tax expense

nodes.name: Statement of Cash Flows
nodes.description: Cash inflows and outflows by activity

children.name: Cash Flow from Operating Activities
children.description: Cash flows from primary business operations

children.name: Change in Deferred Revenue
children.description: Working capital change in deferred revenue

children.name: Cash Flow from Investing Activities
children.description: Cash flows from investments and asset purchases

children.name: Intangible Asset Acquisitions
children.description: Cash used for intangible asset purchases

children.name: Loans Issued
children.description: Cash used for loans to third parties

children.name: Cash Flow from Financing Activities
children.description: Cash flows from debt and equity financing

children.name: Beginning Equity
children.description: Equity balance at start of period

children.name: Ending Equity
children.description: Equity balance at end of period

children.name: Income Taxes
children.description: Tax rate reconciliation, deferred tax components

children.name: Subsequent Events
children.description: Events after the balance sheet date
